_: Classification of tuning-catalogue fields and engine constants for the voicematch fitter, read by knobs.load_knob_classes. Built from the tuning catalogue (types read from the I/I_TYPED declarations in patch_tuning.cpp); each entry's `family` is the voice family it belongs to (`keyed`, `struck`, `sustained`, `synth`, or `bank-wide`). Keys are patch-field paths without the patch prefix (`brass.mute`, `waveform`) or `<file stem>.<kName>` for engine constants; `[*]` stands for the catalogue's numeric suffix (`modes0`, `ranks3`, `ops1`, `drawbars4`) and `*` in a name is a glob. Every entry must name a key the catalogue reports, or loading fails. Classes: `identity` is never searched by `--spec auto`; `switch` is a bool, a two-valued field or an integer-valued selector, never searched as a continuum; `set_by_measurement` fields are placed from measured data and never searched; `stage_enable` is decided per patch from the shipped value - left out where the patch ships the stage absent (`off_value`, default 0, within `off_within`), and searched with the off value excluded from the range where it ships present; `compensating_group` members are searched together (`--open-group <group>`) or not at all, each with the `evidence` its membership rests on. `pinned` is one voice's field, keyed `<patch>.<field>` with the patch included, held at its `value`, and `basis` states the measurement or constraint that pins it: `--spec auto` never offers it and a spec naming it is refused, so a pin is changed by editing the entry; its `value` is compared with what the library ships and a differing one is flagged at start-up. An entry without a class only records a `gates` note. `notes` explain fields no override reaches; `declared_not_in_engine` holds entries declared but not yet in the engine (keys the library does not report), exempt from the resolve check; `switch_candidates` lists float-typed fields whose shipped values across the bank are all integers, for a list to judge, and is regenerated with the table. `type` is `int` (I) or `switch` (I_TYPED) and is read from patch_tuning.cpp, not from a family.

additive.drawbars[*].basis: drawbar registration that names the organ preset

additive.drawbars_b[*].basis: drawbar registration that names the organ preset

additive.percussion_harmonic.basis: which harmonic the percussion uses (int 0/2/3), or none

amp_env.sustain.basis: 0 = a one-shot: the envelope ends the note on its own; a sustain level rings until a note-off, which no gate window reaches past and a drum part never sends

body.basis: BodyType enum: which resonant body is attached

bowed_string.string_tension_n.basis: string geometry the instrument is defined by (hyperbolic junction only); borderline, a measured quantity

brass.mute.basis: a mute on a patch that ships unmuted (stage_enable-like if the patch ships muted and the mute is being voiced)

brass.mute_norm.basis: 0 = the mute pair stays normalised at DC, with no level given back at the fundamental

clarinet.body_mix.basis: ruled: on the sustained scan the only surviving term that reads it is held-window crest, four phase-sensitive snapshots (stored-waveform groups) against a measured 3 dB of upper partials, which does not identify body_mix

trombone.cutoff_hz.basis: ruled: the bell carries level and register better than the post-voice lowpass (gain-removed level RMS against the reference 1.12 vs 2.53, register 0.94 vs 2.10, ladder 5.48 vs 6.42), but a fixed-hertz corner low enough to darken the low notes leaves fewer than about three supported partials at the top and h2 falls (n64 -8.8 vs -4.6 dB); bell-only is re-tested when the corner can follow the note (sustained trombone_grid and bell grids)

filter_model.basis: filter topology / tap enum; a type, not a setting

filter_output.basis: filter topology / tap enum; a type, not a setting

fm.ops[*].ratio.basis: operator frequency ratio; integer or near-integer ratios define the spectrum family

harpsichord.peak_velocity.basis: uint8 velocity at which the instrument tops out; unclamped

harpsichord.undamped_from_note.basis: uint8 note above which strings have no dampers (128 = never); unclamped

modal.modes[*].key_slope.basis: octave drift of untuned upper modes; separates a tuned from a short untuned bar

modal.num_modes.basis: size of the mode set; int clamp [0,kMaxModalModes]

percussion.base_freq_hz.basis: pitch of a tuned drum/bar; free voicing only on noise-only pieces; [0,20000]

percussion.mode_alpha[*].basis: Bessel zeros of the ideal membrane, independent of mode_ratios; float [0,64]

percussion.noise_burst_count.basis: number of VCA retriggers (clap vs single burst); a count of repeated attacks; override bound [0,8]

percussion.noise_output.basis: SynthFilterOutput enum, LP/BP/HP of the noise path; unclamped

percussion.shell_freq_hz[*].basis: shell mode count (int clamp [0,kMaxShellModes]) and its identity frequency table

percussion.shell_num_modes.basis: shell mode count (int clamp [0,kMaxShellModes]) and its identity frequency table

piano.decay_stretch.basis: tuning stretch of the decay law across the keyboard; instrument property, not touch

piano.detune_cents.basis: unison mistuning; a tuning state, fit only when the reference's own beating is the target

piano.dispersion.basis: string stiffness; scale design that moves every partial; fitted for the grand only, against three references

piano.strike_position.basis: hammer position along the string; scale design, places the comb notch, a fit trades it for ladder error

piano.strings.basis: integer string count per key; sets the unison layout, a continuous search changes what the instrument is

piano_voice.kContactPeriodsMax.basis: limit or structure bound, not voicing

piano_voice.kHammerMfVel.basis: the excitation chain's pivot: the velocity every level anchor is defined against; moving it re-defines the other constants

piano_voice.kStrikeNoiseMaxMs.basis: limit or structure bound, not voicing

pipe_organ.rank_count.basis: integer rank count; 0 = implicit single 8' from the flat fields, above 0 gates the flat stopped/brightness/reed/radiation and all ranks.*

plucked_string.inharmonicity_b.basis: stiff-string B; per-instrument constant, a fit moves it only with a reason

reed.closing_pressure.basis: above 0 selects the Bernoulli valve, 0 the table valve (gate for zeta, pressure_scale); only the 0 vs non-zero switch is identity

unison.basis: oscillator stack size; lround-rounded integer, 2.78 renders as 3 on program 88

va.osc2_interval_cents.basis: interval of the layer (octave, fifth); names the patch's chord, clamped to +-2400

vocal.vowel.basis: integer index into the vowel table, selects the formant set

waveform.basis: VaWaveform enum: the oscillator family a GM synth slot names

bowed_string.elasto_plastic.basis: selects the bristle friction model; active only when hyperbolic is off; gate for stribeck

bowed_string.hyperbolic_friction.basis: selects the hyperbolic friction junction (gate for string_tension_n, string_length_m, force_ratio)

flute.jet_cycle_mean.basis: cycle-mean jet model; active only with jet_drive; gate for jet_deflection_limit

flute.jet_drive.basis: selects jet-drive source vs cubic source; gate for jet_offset, jet_receptivity_window, jet_cycle_mean, jet_deflection_limit

flute.loop_phase_servo.basis: servo regime of the cubic source; active only when jet_drive is false

free_reed.musette_flat.basis: flat musette tuning selector; active only when detune > 0

ks.harmonic_node.basis: 0 = open string, above 0 = harmonic node; an integer-valued selector, [0,8]

ks.mute_harmonic.basis: integer-valued selector of the muted harmonic; [0,16]

modal.mallet_shape.basis: ContactShape enum, raised cosine vs Gaussian

percussion.gm_kit.basis: bool: the patch becomes the whole GM kit; unclamped

piano_voice.kHammerJunction.basis: engine switch, removed at junction adoption

piano_voice.kInjImpulseNorm.basis: selects which quantity the injection is normalised to, 0 or 1

piano_voice.kKnockUncombed.basis: 0/1 routing choice written as a lerp

pipe_organ.stopped.basis: stopped vs open pipe (flat voicing, rank_count 0)

reed.dynamic_reed.basis: enables the mass-spring reed valve (gate for reed_resonance); the bank's record says it must stay off

modal.modes[*].ratio.basis: bar/plate partial series defines the instrument; float, not searched as a set

percussion.mode_ratios[*].basis: partial series, the head/bar/plate identity; independent of mode_alpha

pitch_offset_cents.basis: placed from measured pitch, never searched; also in knobs.py AUTO_SKIP_SUFFIXES

bowed_string.section_spread_cents.basis: non-zero turns one player into a section (gate for section_rate_hz)

bowed_string.string_loss_harmonic.basis: 0 = no harmonic-indexed loss stage (gate for string_loss_per_octave)

fm.ops[*].feedback.basis: FM operator feedback stage, absent at 0

free_reed.onset_breath_overshoot_db.basis: 0 = no onset overshoot (gate for settle, vel, key fields)

free_reed.slot_duty.basis: 0 = no reed-slot mechanism (gate for slot_return, slot_gap, slot_swing, radiation)

harpsichord.board_diffuse_db.basis: soundboard diffusion level in dB; absent at -120 (anything at or below -119)

notes.brass.bell_cutoff_hz: not identifiable apart from the patch's post-voice cutoff_hz on a brass-engine patch: the bell corner (with brass.brightness) and the post-voice lowpass both supply the voice's darkness and a fit must not open both; trombone 144-render grid (lowpass opened worsens h1 share 4-8 dB at every lip aperture with the bell held), brass_section carries the same arrangement (570 Hz under a 5.8 kHz corner) and is not yet measured; not enforced until spec composition is checked
notes.piano_voice.k*Capacity: static constexpr array size, not reachable by an override
notes.mode: SynthEngineMode, reported by the catalogue as a #mode line; not reachable by an override
notes.mod_matrix.routes[*].*: not reachable by an override; the route depth is a recorded missing reach (kLfo2 -> kAmpGain tremolo on e_piano_2, tremolo_strings, vibraphone)
notes.percussion.mode_m[*]: uint8 azimuthal order of each mode; not reachable by an override

reach._: Fields whose movement only a particular gated dimension can judge. `--spec auto` opens such a field only where the capture's gate (reference/<capture>_gate.json) holds a bound for every dimension in `requires`; otherwise nothing would hold what the fit moves. A pattern follows the same rules as `entries` and must name a key the catalogue reports, or loading fails. A hand spec keeps the knob and warns.

lfo*_rate_hz.basis: LFO rate of the VA and lead engines; audible only as modulation over time

lfo_to_*.basis: LFO depth into pitch; audible only as modulation over time

drift_cents.basis: slow pitch drift depth; audible only as movement over time

drift_rate_hz.basis: slow pitch drift rate; audible only as movement over time

*.vibrato_*.basis: vibrato rate and depth of the flute and vocal engines; audible only as modulation over time

vocal_voice.kVibratoMaxFrac.basis: ceiling on the vocal vibrato depth

*.tremolo_*.basis: phase of the modal tremolo between modes; audible only as amplitude modulation over time

stereo_spread.basis: interchannel spread; invisible to a mono measurement

va.unison_width.basis: stereo difference of the unison stack (native_synth_voice.h)

amp_env.release_ms.basis: acts after the key lift, which only damper_release_ms reads; the held-note dimensions end at note-off
